name: A Guide to Manually Upgrading Web UI.docx
path: SmartByte/暂时不用的/A Guide to Manually Upgrading Web UI.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Purpose
This manual is drafted for administrators to manually upgrade the WEB GUI(without our intervention)
Log-in
Web  UI
Typically, a simple WEB GUI change involves 5 parts:
IP Address
Logo
Product ID
Product SN
MAC Address
Please talk with us if there are any unrespondings in your operation or you need more complex changes
After a customized order, there will be a ZIP file including your customization information
We will usually not share it with clients, just keep it for future orders or tracking purpose
Please talk with us for this ZIP file before manual upgrade
Logo
In this ZIP file, there will be logo_dark and logo_light photos
Logo_dark is for log-in change while logo_light is for WEB GUI change
prepare the new logo
take both screenshots in PNG format and name them EXACTLY logo_dark and logo_light
Please keep the new screenshots as closest as to old ones regarding size and pixels
No need to use large-size screenshots, this will reduce loading speed
Logo_dark: just a regular screenshot
Logo_light: a transparent background is required to properly display on the blue part as shown above
replace the old ones(logo_dark and logo_light)
Model
In this ZIP file, there will be a config file as shown above
change it to new model name
save
IP Address
In this ZIP file, there will be 2 files as shown above
The inner content is the same, just different file format
change the IP address and gateway information of both files
save
After this, please upload this revised file via the following path
Maintenance>File Management>Data Management>Upload
Then the system will reboot without human intervention
After rebooting, if the logo&model name keep unchanged, please refresh(CRTL+F5)
SN & MAC
Plug the serial port cable into the device
Open the serial port tool, such as putty, secureCRT, and set the baud rate to 115200
Start the device
Enter the space bar to enter uboot
Execute the "print_p" command to print out the device MAC address, SN, hardware version number and other information.
Execute the burn MAC command
product_set ID SN MAC VER, the product model cannot be changed, SN, MAC, VER can be entered as needed
ID: product model, internal use, cannot be changed
MAC: MAC address
SN: A combination of letters and numbers, usually 12 digits
VER: Hardware version, supports letter and number combinations
product_set LTIE-MAC3L-8GT4XS4GS-6XRPC 202411060001 78:d0:64:66:9a:50 1.0
After the execution is completed, execute the print_p command again to check whether it is correct.
Modification of MAC is completed
Then please power off and restart the device
